title: Shadow Mist
text: Release an unrecoverable cloud against a block. It expands from one to three blocks wide over one second, then fades away over its twenty-second lifetime. Living creatures inside receive ten seconds of Darkness.
Forge mist in the assembly table center with six shadow berries to obtain a dark microcore.
A light microcore neutralizes the cloud and becomes a dark microcore. Neutralized mist no longer refreshes Darkness or converts further microcores; existing effects expire normally.
